problem_statement: The power management policy API lacks a way to lock all power states at once with a single reference-counted lock. A caller who wants to prevent the system from entering any power state (equivalent to requesting zero exit latency but with a simpler, faster interface) must instead lock each state individually. Add pm_policy_state_all_lock_get() and pm_policy_state_all_lock_put() functions that use a reference counter: while the counter is non-zero, pm_policy_state_lock_is_active() returns true for every state, pm_policy_state_is_available() returns false for every state, and pm_policy_state_any_active() returns false. Releasing the lock (counter back to zero) restores the previous per-state behavior.
